messages:
maria-ng: Postmortem for Cygnus Dedicated is published. Need to lock owners and ETAs for follow-ups so we can close the loop with the customer.

maria-ng: TL;DR - intermittent tenant isolation from stale on‑prem BGP export policy during maint, plus a peering-agent retry race that delayed route reannouncements.

jonathan: I'll own the peering-agent fix. Plan: small patch that resets backoff on success, add unit test for rapid flaps, deploy canary to Dedicated. ETA: patch+canary Thu EOD.

alex_k: I'll own the customer-facing runbook and walkthrough. Need router commands from Ryan to include exact steps. ETA: Fri EOD.

ryan_ops: Cygnus uses Juniper MX480. Useful checks: `show configuration policy-options prefix-list cygnus-exports` and to force reannounce: `request route reannounce family inet.` Will add example CLI snippet to the shared doc.

tamika: I'll add a synthetic peering probe that compares route tables from both sides and alerts on >30s divergence. Will create Grafana tile and an alert; ETA: Mon.

incident-bot: Created ticket RDW-4312 assigned jonathan: "Cygnus - peering agent retry race".

maria-ng: Consolidated action items posted to the remediation tracker: 1) peering-agent patch (owner: jonathan, ETA: 2101238400) 2) runbook & walkthrough (owner: alex_k, ETA: 2101242000) 3) synthetic probe + dashboard (owner: tamika, ETA: 2101245600) 4) customer email + timeline (owner: maria-ng, ETA: 2101237800).

jonathan: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/peering-agent/pull/481. Canary started. Will update with health checks.

(10m later)
jonathan: Canary healthy so far, no route flaps for 20m. Promoting to 50% on Dedicated shard set.

ryan_ops: Ops will watch BGP sessions and route tables during rollout windows; suggest Dedicated-first 48h canary.

tamika: Probe + dashboard added: https://grafana.redwood/d/cygnus-peering. Wired alert RDW-ALERT-920 to open major if >=2 customers exhibit isolation in 7d.

maria-ng: Good progression. I'll send the Cygnus update after 50% canary is stable and schedule a 72h follow-up to confirm no recurrence before closing items. :thumbsup:
